checks.name: empty_created_at
checks.detail: Empty timestamp retains autogenerated-date retry semantics.

checks.name: cancelled_stop
checks.detail: Cancelled stop caller cannot abort accepted work; admission is closed.

checks.name: worker_cancel_during_commit
checks.detail: Repeated worker cancellation waits for in-flight commit; queued future fails explicitly.

checks.name: future_cancel_during_commit
checks.detail: Cancelled result future does not abort its accepted transaction or kill the worker.

checks.name: failed_rollback
checks.detail: Unconfirmed rollback poisons worker, fails queued requests, and connection close leaves no partial row.

checks.name: startup_failure_restart
checks.detail: Startup failure terminates all accepted requests; explicit restart recovers with a fresh queue.

checks.name: cancel_before_worker_entry
checks.detail: Done callback fails accepted requests even when worker was cancelled before entering its body.

checks.name: queue_capacity_and_terminal_futures
checks.detail: All 4096 accepted queued requests terminate on initialization cancellation; overflow is rejected.

checks.name: key_and_metadata_rejections
checks.detail: Absent/wrong keys and changed semantics reject without rewriting original ciphertext; later valid requests succeed.

checks.name: encrypted_retry_across_event_loops
checks.detail: One actor reuses three distinct asyncio.run loops; encrypted retry keeps original row/result.
